name: Kim Petras
description:
'''Kim Petras''' ({{IPAc-en|'|p|ɛ|t|r|ə|s}}; {{IPA|de|ˈpeːtʁas|lang}}; born 27 August 1992) is a German singer and songwriter based in [[Los Angeles]]. After receiving international media attention for [[Gender transition|transitioning]] as a teenager, she released her debut [[Extended play|EP]], ''One Piece of Tape'' (2011), and wrote tracks for [[Fergie (singer)|Fergie]], [[JoJo (singer)|JoJo]], [[Skylar Simone]], and [[Twice]]. In 2017, Petras released her debut single "[[I Don't Want It at All]]", which charted at No. 54 on [[Billboard (magazine)|''Billboard'']]{{'s}} [[Dance Club Songs]] chart. She followed this with her second EP, ''[[Turn Off the Light, Vol. 1]]'' (2018), the mixtapes [[Clarity (mixtape)|''Clarity'']] and [[Turn Off the Light (mixtape)|''Turn Off the Light'']] (both 2019), and the single "[[How It's Done (Kash Doll, Kim Petras, Alma and Stefflon Don song)|How It's Done]]" (2019); the last of these featured on [[Charlie's Angels: Original Motion Picture Soundtrack|the soundtrack]] of [[Charlie's Angels (2019 film)|''Charlie's Angels'']]. A further track with [[Kygo]], "[[Broken Glass (Kygo and Kim Petras song)|Broken Glass]]" (2020), charted at No. 13 on ''Billboard''{{'}}s [[Dance/Electronic Songs]] chart.

In 2021, Petras signed a record deal with [[Dr. Luke]]'s Amigo Records and [[Republic Records]]. That year, she became the first transgender act to perform at the [[MTV Video Music Awards]], [[MTV Europe Music Awards]], and [[Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade]]. Her 2022 EP, ''[[Slut Pop]]'', featured "Throat Goat", which went viral in 2023 after a [[sign language interpreter]] provided an explicit translation at Sydney [[WorldPride]]. She also featured on [[Sam Smith]]'s "[[Unholy (Sam Smith and Kim Petras song)|Unholy]]" in 2022, which charted at number one in twenty countries including on the [[Billboard Hot 100|''Billboard'' Hot 100]] and subsequently won a [[Grammy Award for Best Pop Duo/Group Performance]], making her the first openly transgender woman to top that chart or win a Grammy in that category.

Petras followed "Unholy" with the single "[[Alone (Kim Petras and Nicki Minaj song)|Alone]]" (with [[Nicki Minaj]]), which peaked at No. 55 on the chart, and preceded her debut studio album, [[Feed the Beast (Kim Petras album)|''Feed the Beast'']] (2023), which charted at No. 44 on the [[Billboard 200|''Billboard'' 200]]. Her subsequent releases include the albums, ''[[Problématique]]'' (2023) and [[Detour (Kim Petras album)|''Detour'']] (2026), as well as the EP, ''[[Slut Pop Miami]]'' (2024). Before the release of the latter album, she left Republic Records following the label's refusal of its release.  

Petras has also released the tracks "[[Unlock It]]" (2017, with [[Charli XCX]]) and "[[Reminds Me]]" (2020), which have been covered by [[Piri & Tommy]] and by [[the Kid Laroi]] and [[Juice Wrld]] respectively, and featured in the films ''[[The Bitch Who Stole Christmas]]'' (2021) and ''[[This Is Me... Now: A Love Story]]'' (2024), the series ''Bridesman'' (2022), the [[Amazon Music]] documentary ''The Lead Up'' (2022), and a [[RuPaul's Drag Race: UK vs. the World series 2|series two]] episode of ''[[RuPaul's Drag Race: UK vs. the World]]'' (2024).
